events.name: Events & Open Play
events.label: ALL LEVELS · ONGOING
events.blurb: Find your level, rotate into games, and meet the Dink Club community — no full group needed. Reserved sessions by skill level on 6 outdoor courts. Grab your spot online before you come.

events.name: Beginner Pickleball
events.label: Wednesday's
events.blurb: Join us every Wednesday from 6–8 PM at Dink Club for Beginner & Intermediate Round-Robin Play! These welcoming sessions are designed specifically for newer and entry-level players—so there’s no pressure and no need to feel intimidated. Everyone is learning, playing, and having fun together! 😊

events.name: Burgers & Beers Social
events.label: Oct 18th
events.blurb:
Ready for the perfect Sunday night?

Join us at Dink Club for a fun-filled Pickleball Round Robin featuring great games, delicious burgers, cold beer, and an awesome community!

📅 Sunday, October 18th
⏰ 6:30–9:30 PM
🎟️ Only $15 per person

Your admission includes:

🏓 Fun round-robin pickleball
🍔 Complimentary burgers
🍺 Complimentary beer
🤝 A great opportunity to play and meet new people

All skill levels are welcome, and you can register individually—no partner needed!

Spots are limited, so register now on Court Reserve and join us for an evening of pickleball, burgers, beer, and good vibes!

events.name: Up & Down The River
events.label: Oct 19th
events.blurb:
Ready to climb your way to the top?

Join us at Dink Club for Up & Down the River, a fast-paced pickleball event featuring rotating partners and constant court movement!

📅 Monday, October 19th
⏰ 8–10 PM
🎟️ $10 per player
🏓 Minimum of six games
👤 No partner needed

How it works:

⬆️ Win your game and move up a court
⬇️ Lose your game and move down a court
🔄 Split from your partner and rotate every round
🏆 Keep winning to reach—and remain on—Championship Court!

It’s a fun way to meet new players, test your skills, and enjoy plenty of competitive pickleball.

featured.title: Calendar
featured.body: September is shaping up to be an incredible month at Dink Club Pickleball Courts! Whether you’re looking for competitive play, beginner-friendly events, food and fun, or simply a court to enjoy with friends, there’s something on the calendar for you.

details: • Weekly Open Play and Recreational Round Robins
• Men’s, Ladies’ and Mixed Mini Moneyball Tournaments 💰
